span.p:
After partition heals: Two primaries, divergent data.
Replica B's data wins (it was promoted by the majority).
Primary A's writes during the partition are lost.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Prevention: sentinel-avoid-protection-level (use majority)
Use min-replicas-to-write and min-replicas-max-lag
to stop writes when replication fails
